title: Observability data governance: PII redaction, retention lifecycles, RBAC & access auditing
creator: Ava Chen
description: Scope: Implement platform-level observability data governance covering automated PII redaction at ingestion, configurable retention lifecycles per-tenant/per-environment, and robust RBAC + immutable access logging for observability artifacts (traces, logs, metrics indices). Goals: prevent accidental sensitive data exposure in traces/logs, give customers deterministic retention controls, and produce auditable access trails for compliance. This ticket covers design and initial implementation for hosted and Dedicated modes; Private (on-prem/VPC) optional configuration will be documented but not shipped in this sprint.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Ingestion pipeline supports configurable redaction rules (regex and structured field blacklists) applied before storage for traces and logs. 2) Retention policies per-organization and per-dataset with enforcement (automatic delete or move-to-archive) and UI/API control. 3) RBAC model implemented for observability UI and API endpoints with role mappings and fine-grained permissions. 4) Immutable access logs produced for any read or export of observability data; logs must be queryable and exportable. 5) Backfill tool to retroactively redact PII from stored logs/traces without breaking indexes; performance and cost impact documented. 6) Unit/integration tests and a canary rollout on non-prod for validation.
comments: 2026-02-25 - Ava Chen: Created ticket after incident post-mortem where customer trace contained keys. Initial spike showed two paths for redaction: (A) inline redaction in ingest workers, (B) post-ingest streaming processor. Inline is lower blast radius but harder for structured fields. Proposal: hybrid — inline redaction of obvious patterns + streaming processor for richer structured rules.

2026-02-28 - Diego Martinez: Implemented prototype for inline redaction using the ingest lambda. Pushed branch feat/obs/pii-redact. Preliminary numbers: adds ~6ms P95 to ingest path; needs benchmarking. Linked PR for review.

2026-03-02 - Priya Kapoor (Security): Reviewed regex whitelist approach. Warned about perf and false positives. Recommended adding 'allowlist' tokens and adding an escape hatch for customers to opt-out (explicit consent) with strong guardrails and contract update.

2026-03-04 - Product (Liam O'Neill): PM alignment — must expose retention settings in Console and API; default retention for hosted customers = 90 days for logs, 30 days for traces unless customer upgrades. Confirmed enterprise customers can request custom retention via Dedicated/Private.

2026-03-07 - Diego Martinez: Implemented RBAC prototype using existing authz service; created roles: obs_reader, obs_analyst, obs_admin, obs_exporter. PR #1982 includes middleware to emit access events to audit-log topic. Need review for audit schema.

2026-03-10 - QA (Sara Li): Found a gap: span attributes with nested JSON were not redacted by regex-only approach. Added test cases and recommended adding structured parsers for common languages (JSON, URL-encoded).

2026-03-12 - Diego Martinez: Updated design to add a structured-field rule engine and retention worker with throttled deletions. Added migration plan notes. Ready for security review and infra sizing for storage churn.
audit_plan: Access events: every read/export of observability data emits an immutable audit record to the audit-log topic with fields: timestamp, user_id, service, action, target_resource, filter_query, request_id, result_size. Audit records are retained 1 year and signed in storage. Console will show recent audit events for org admins. We will integrate with SIEM via connector. Event schema documented in Confluence attachment.
migration_plan: Backfill tool will scan log/traces indices and perform streaming redaction + reindexing into a new sanitized index when necessary. For each org we will: 1) snapshot index, 2) run redaction worker in batches (configurable batch size to limit cluster load), 3) swap alias to new index, 4) retire old index or move to cold storage pending legal. For large orgs >1PB we will provide 'archive-and-redact' option and coordinate maintenance windows. Migration will be opt-in for the first release; full auto-backfill deferred to next milestone.
cost_estimate: $3,200/month additional storage/IO for typical mid-market backlog; engineering effort approx 2 devs x 3 sprints + 1 SRE for rollout and infra automation. License/third-party redaction tool not planned initially.
testing_plan: Unit tests for regex and structured parsers; integration tests via replay harness on staging dataset; fuzz tests for pattern detection; performance benchmarks (ingest latency P50/P95/P99) before and after; privacy validation with sample PIIs. Canary rollout to 10% of production orgs with monitoring for false-positive redactions and ingest errors.
rollout_strategy: Phase 1 (Sprint): enable default redaction for new orgs and non-prod; provide API flag for existing customers to opt-in. Phase 2: gradual rollout to hosted orgs with telemetry, customer notifications, and support playbook. Dedicated customers receive config bundle and migration assistance.
